strings.en: I decided for myself that I'd fight!
There are things I won't give up, either...!
Right now, I can take the initiative...!
If you're going to stand in my way!
I'll handle the Leonysis Harga, too!
Its traits are different, but it's a Leonysis!
I'm counting on you, Leonysis Varga!
The Leonysis Varga can do it!
They didn't entrust the Varga to me for nothing!
I don't care about your grudges, Jua-Mu!
I won't say I understand/　everything that person feels, but...
She and the Raftclans are both tough foes...!
If I can punch a hole in the encirclement...!
There's not one wasted move. It's eerie...
If that man gets his way,/　the Fury people will...!
You know the disaster the Cross Gate brings,/　and still you...!
Gu-Landon!/　The Cross Gate's disaster will come back on you, too!
If only you hadn't come to Rabulpaila...!
I won't let that man stall for time...!
Gomoudokka Golaikunru.../　If I can defeat that man...!
Even if they curse me as a traitor...!
I won't aim for the cockpit...!
I was ready for this, but...!
We want to know the truth, Captain!
I can't let Reggiane hold me back...!
I won't hand you Gadisword's future/　or the Cross Gate!
Herluga! Perish here along with your ambitions!
I have to watch out for Debudedabide's arts...!
I won't end up being treated as bait!
Even against Dragous, I can't flinch!
Getting attacks through that body won't be easy...!
If its wings are hurt, it should slow down...!
Something that moves with only bones... Creepy...!
Whatever the Skull Knights want,/　it's sure to harm Gadisword, too!
I won't let Earth become like our home planet!
We'll defeat XN-L with our own hands!
I'll shoot down that Zovorg machine!
With data, it's easier to predict its moves!
You didn't even judge who was worth using!
I won't flinch even against a commander unit!
To think something like that exists on Earth...!
There's no way I can leave something like that be!
Concentrate our attacks, and even a Kaana Type falls!
I can't let the Kaana Type do as it pleases!
Even if it's bigger than a Kaana Type!
I have to take down the Ida Type, fast!
It's hard to believe we could/　make contact with that, but!
I'll stop the Skull Knights' plans, no matter what!
We can't let it get away!
I can still trace it... I can do this!
You misjudged what I'm capable of!
Staying in the same spot? Really?
I have no choice but to eject...!
What's that sound?! Which motor got hit?!
I have no intention of falling halfway to my goal!
Th-There must still be something I can do...!
If I let my guard down for a second, I'll be shot down...!
I-If I die here, what was it all for...!
Fu-Ruu... We haven't settled this yet!
Y-You failed to finish me, Karo-Ran!
I can't complain about being attacked, but...!
I didn't leave Rabulpaila on a half-hearted resolve!
Bilgo, I won't lose to you!
A-At this rate, the Captain will...!
Ugh! If Reggiane takes me down here...!
You won't get the Cross Gate! Even if it costs my life!
I have to escape those four eyes...!
I won't give in to XN-L!
In a place like this, to the Lamaris...!
If the Ares Geist follows up now...!
I have to draw out this machine's full potential!
Backing off carelessly would be even more dangerous!
Ngh, I have to recover right away!
I can't keep being targeted like this...!
I'll have to apologize to Sieg later...!
It's okay... It's okay, Leonysis Varga.
Jua-Mu's momentum is pushing me back...!
His skills as a pilot are the real deal, too...!
Even if they brand me a rebel, I...!
I can't fall while I'm still a traitor...!
It's to protect Rabulpaila.../　So they're desperate, too...!
Not yet! I'm not going down yet, Bilgo!
If I lose to Bilgo,/　how could I ever stop Herluga...!
Having the Captain as an enemy is this hard...!
Captain! I'll follow the path I believe in!
I can't shake off Reggiane's Gyanonia...!
I won't let you overpower me, Reggiane!
Herluga! Your power won't swallow me!
Is that thing laughing at me?!
Moving so flexibly with a body like that...!
At this rate, the Skull Knight will...!
XN-L! We will never be erased!
I have to get into the Zeranio-class's blind spot!
No way am I getting taken down by that thing!
I can't keep up with the Lamaris...!
Ugh, the Steel Dragons fought foes like this/　so many times...?!
This much damage won't hinder me in combat!
Forget the damage, I'm moving forward!
That won't even work as a feint!
I hesitated, and my evasion was too slow!
You think that's enough to stop me?!
The Leonysis can still take it!
This much won't bring down the Varga!
I can't imagine that man holding back, but...!
If that's a feint, it's useless, Iradoya!
Is this part of your calculations too, Gomoudokka?!
If this is the price of betrayal...!
Even against you, I won't stop...!
Knowing the moves and being able/　to counter them are two different things...!
Ngh, the Captain read my moves...!
Reggiane, you're trying to buy time...!
You know very well how dangerous/　that gate is!
Debudedabide, that won't make me flinch!
Crystal Dragoon... It's faster than I thought!
Don't think you can destroy us so easily,/　XN-L!
Ngh, I couldn't get through the barrage!
I have to beat them before the Lamaris surround me...!
I can't afford to take damage!
You can't catch the Leonysis Harga!
Looks like you can't catch the Varga!
If I stay alert, I can handle even Fu-Ruu!
Gu-Landon!/　In the end, you're no different from Herluga!
Iradoya, you thought I'd be easy, didn't you?!
Of course they won't go easy on me...!
If only you'd give up and turn back...!
I can't back down either, Captain!
You're dead wrong if you think everything will go/　your way, Herluga!
You won't hit me, Crystal Dragoon!
For the sake of the survivors,/　I have to stop XN-L here!
I'll hold my own even against a high-performance unit!
The Lamaris's movements won't fool me!
The Lamaris Ida has me targeted...!
Looks like you didn't expect this evasive motion!
If I'd reacted any slower, that would've been close...!
That thing is absurd beyond belief!
That trick won't work on me!
I thought I was being careful, but...!
I can't believe I lost the enemy...
I have to move to a good position, quick!
I can pull off improvised teamwork, too!
Princess Shine, leave this to me!
Akimi, leave the rest to me!
If I can support the Bellzelute Brigandi!
I'll buy time for the retreat!
I won't let you have your way!
I won't let them get Akimi!
The Granteed Dracodeus is being targeted!
I'll target them all at once!
Make the most of your speed!
High-mobility combat, I can do this!
First, I'll pin down the enemy's movements!
I won't miss at this range!
If I concentrate the Varga's firepower...!
I don't care if I use up every shot!
Not yet, not yet, not yeeet!
It's simple, so its power is easy to grasp!
With this, any armor will give!
I hear these missiles are a luxury, but I'll use them!
If I just dive right in...!
I'll slam you with the Type-2's power!
Because I can't stop in a place like this...!
If I ram it with this huge body...!
You can't escape this storm of bearing rounds!
I'll take this to close combat!
I'll show you a continuous attack!
I won't give you a chance to escape!
It can be used like this, too!
By the way, what exactly is Ankensatsu?
Goousatsu... I don't really get what it means.
I'll draw out everything the Boxer has!
I'll hit you with the Gunner's maximum firepower!
Phoenix Showdown... I'll pull it off!
Try to stand out, Ponytail Copycat.
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
The Leonysis couldn't do an attack like this.
Wanna ride with me next time?
